comment: Inputs for make_table.py that are not benchmark numbers: the decision rule tolerances, which clip stands for which format, configurations excluded for a measured reason, and rows for formats the power benchmark does not cover.

exclude.reason: B-08: zero-copy stalled at start in 12/40 and 5/60 cold opens, copy-back 0/80 on GLES

operatingRate.comment: P6-08 fix: MediaCodec operating-rate hint per row. auto = about 2 x the clip fps (60..240; 120 when the fps is unknown and the clip is >= 4K or 10-bit HEVC), off = none. Software-only rows always get off. Device A/B 2026-10-15 (docs/BENCHMARK.md): HEVC 10-bit 4K 60 fps 1027 -> 0 drops with operating_rate=120; battery cost not measured yet (TASKS.md P6-08).
